nodes.label: Homepage 4-Slide Sales Deck
nodes.rationale: v1.1.0 restructured the homepage from a minimal feature list into a 4-slide, funnel-ordered sales deck, each slide targeting one audience (renters/buyers, owners, developers/commercial, how-it-works) with a single CTA.

nodes.label: SlideShell Background Slot (full-bleed fix)
nodes.rationale: .reveal.visible carries a CSS transform, which makes the content container the containing block for absolute positioning; the absolute inset-0 gradient was therefore clipped to the 1600px content width on wide monitors (visible only with animations active). Fix: render the background at <section> level via a new SlideShell 'background' slot, outside the .reveal transform container, leaving the content layout unchanged.

nodes.label: Server Actions Migration (v0.6.0)
nodes.rationale: Mutations moved from API routes to Server Actions as the idiomatic Next 16 / React 19 approach; client components call actions via useTransition, router.refresh replaced by revalidatePath, 12 mutation API routes removed. Auth/OTP endpoints stay as routes because they need cookies, redirects and rate limiting.

nodes.label: Sonner Toast Feedback
nodes.rationale: v0.5.0 replaced the grey status boxes with sonner toasts across all forms and actions; success and error are visually distinct and auto-dismiss.

nodes.label: QES Contract Signing
nodes.rationale: Each party signs via a pluggable QES provider (simulated in dev); when both signatures land the contract becomes ACTIVE, the property RENTED, and the first rent falls due.

nodes.label: KYC Identity Verification
nodes.rationale: Real face matching between a live ID-document capture and a selfie, with no auto-approval; phone-camera KYC works without HTTPS in dev.

nodes.label: BNR EUR/RON Exchange-Rate Feed
nodes.rationale: EUR/RON rate comes from the official BNR feed cached ~6h, with EUR_RON_RATE as a manual override and a fallback when the feed is unavailable.

nodes.label: S3/R2-Compatible Storage
nodes.rationale: Checksums forced to WHEN_REQUIRED because the AWS SDK v3 default corrupts uploads on Cloudflare R2; STORAGE_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE optional.

nodes.label: TOTP Two-Factor Authentication
nodes.rationale: RFC 6238 TOTP with backup codes, enforced on both password login and email-OTP login.

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET Production-Only Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Strict JWT_SECRET enforcement applies only to the real production deployment (VERCEL_ENV=production), so Vercel Preview deployments boot with a fallback dev secret without full configuration. Documented trade-off: preview sessions are signed with a known secret unless JWT_SECRET is also set on Preview.

nodes.label: Isolated Test Database Harness
nodes.rationale: Test harness with an isolated database (prisma/test.db) and mocks for Next APIs (getCurrentUser, next/cache, next/headers); integration test covers the full lifecycle property -> offer -> contract -> sign -> payment.

nodes.label: Dark Mode via CSS Token Redefinition
nodes.rationale: Implemented by redefining the CSS design tokens under html.dark; theme persists in localStorage, respects the system preference, and a no-flash script runs before paint.

nodes.label: Server-Resolved Navbar Auth State
nodes.rationale: Login state is resolved on the server (getNavUser from the cookie) and passed to the Navbar as initialUser, removing the client-fetch auth flash; getCurrentUser is memoized per request with React cache() to avoid duplicate DB queries; the client fetch remains only as a fallback on client error pages.
